items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I got an idea of doing it on flute. And that knocked Bill Robinson out.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then let me be a conductor, go buy me a tuxedo, and let me go and change my tuxedo and be the conductor. Because I had to come out and make some announcements, since(?) Stark was to come on. I used to have to rehearse that speech. It was short. Because all I had to do was just introduce him.

And another beautiful thing I did when I was playing the show... Benny Payne used to play that little thing for Bill Robinson... [SINGS REFRAIN] And I got an idea of doing it on flute. And that knocked Bill Robinson out. [BOTH SING IT] Man, he could dance.
